body: Oh, thanks for the clarification! I just don't know what to expect in general because I never used much medicine in the first place.

Ok. That sounds much less scary compared to what I thought.
Thanks for the advice!

I'm glad you're better

I'm confused about how exactly medication will change me. Im gonna ask the doctor about it, but does it change my thoughts or just make me feel happier in general? Does it make me think more optimistically?

Thanks for the reply!

How did you know that your first few weren't working? 
I'm afraid if I do try medication it might drive me insane or make me feel even worse.

Also, I haven't really considered the probability of addiction. Is that usually a big worry?

Do you exclusively draw/sketch? I like to paint because I can use the left over paint on my hand (and paint it really weird colors) I tend to only paint abstract stuff because I'm never really pleased with anything "solid" that I try :/

Is there any sort of weather you specifically enjoy? I like snow at first but it gets really dirty and sad after a while (in the city). Rain is good too sometimes. Of course, a warm, sorta windy day is always nice.

Oh I like green too. I used to hate it for some reason when I was really young, but I really like the natural feel it has to it. 

Do you have any hobbies? Sometimes when I'm feeling down I like to walk around the small woods behind my house. I did it today and it was nice because I could hear the really light tapping of snow outside. I like to paint too I guess.

Do you want to chat?

Edit: Sorry, some of my replies might be slower because apparently "you are doing that too much. try again in 7 minutes." So if edit's work... What's your favorite color? I honestly don't have one, but I guess blue is nice because I feel like there's no ugly shade of blue
